item.text:
Audited all 81 verse pairs in `nafse-mutmainna.md`. Corrected Roman readings to match the Urdu, including `kabhi`, `meri din ki`, and `tauhid kya`, and standardized Roman spellings and izafat. The Urdu body is byte-for-byte unchanged.

Retained `Zaafar` for ظعفر and `bahattar` for بہتر in the verse about seventy-two heads. These readings remain open to editorial confirmation.
